name: hub-home-tracker-contract
goal: Prove the Hub Home session total follows live Tracker runs when a project also has a flag, while quiet and done projects add no working sessions.

evidence: PR #320 recorded 0 working with 17 live runs. Project-level needs-you took precedence over active and active also included recently touched work.
The Home browser fixture assigned states and sessions directly and never traversed the Tracker read and projection boundary.
Isolated mutation restores the pre-PR #320 state-only working predicate. The strengthened contract fails with expected +0 to be 3.
Use the native items and runs response recording for the existing projection test and browser fixture. Keep working sessions tied to live runs and the ask state independent.
The test-only branch replays the captured responses through readTrackerSources and buildHomeSnapshot in the normal Hub suites. The product correction is already on main.
All six Hub Home data tests pass with the production predicate restored and the same frozen test inputs.
Isolated state-only mutation reports 0 rather than 3 working sessions; restored source tree is identical to the task test commit.
